name: HYPE · Hyperliquid Cash Flow
blurb: Hyperliquid valued as a cash-flowing asset: fees, revenue, buybacks, multiples and market structure.
sources: DefiLlama; Hyperliquid public info API; CoinGecko; OKX; FRED.
description: Treat HYPE like a cash-flowing asset. Live cash-flow read; daily fees vs revenue and cumulative buildup; buyback yield and P/S–P/E multiples over time; live perp volume, open interest, take rate and a per-market table (incl. RWA/TradFi perps); HYPE-vs-BTC rebased performance, rolling correlation and beta (crypto-beta vs hedge); and supply/unlock/dilution vs the buyback burn. Keyless data: DefiLlama (fees/revenue), Hyperliquid API (markets, candles), CoinGecko (mcap), OKX (BTC). Buyback = DefiLlama-revenue proxy; not investment advice.

tiles.description: Cash-Flow Read section header

tiles.name: Cash-Flow Read
tiles.description: Auto-generated cash-flow summary — fees, revenue, buyback yield, multiples, dilution. Recomputed live.
tiles.explain: A written summary generated from the latest Hyperliquid data: fees, revenue, buyback yield, valuation multiples and token dilution.

tiles.name: Valuation & Cash Return
tiles.description: Valuation & Cash Return section header

tiles.name: HYPE Cash-Flow KPIs
tiles.description: Key valuation & cash-flow metrics at a glance.
tiles.explain: Headline cash-flow and valuation figures for Hyperliquid and its HYPE token.

tiles.name: Daily Fees vs Revenue
tiles.description: Daily protocol fees vs revenue (30d averages bold) — the raw cash flow. DefiLlama.
tiles.explain: Fees are everything traders pay to use the exchange each day. Revenue is the portion kept by the protocol, which is used to buy back HYPE tokens, rather than paid to liquidity providers. Shown daily and as 30-day averages.

tiles.name: Cumulative Fees & Revenue
tiles.description: All-time cumulative fees and revenue (≈ cumulative buyback funded).
tiles.explain: Total fees and total protocol revenue since launch. Cumulative revenue approximates the total spent on buying back HYPE.

tiles.name: Buyback Yield
tiles.description: 30d-annualised revenue ÷ market cap — HYPE's 'dividend-like' buyback yield over time.
tiles.explain: The last 30 days of protocol revenue, annualized, divided by HYPE's market value. Because revenue funds token buybacks, it's comparable to a dividend or buyback yield on a stock.

tiles.name: Valuation Multiples
tiles.description: P/S and P/E over the past year (market cap ÷ annualised fees / revenue).
tiles.explain: Price-to-sales (market cap divided by annualized fees) and price-to-earnings (market cap divided by annualized protocol revenue), the same valuation ratios used for listed companies.

tiles.description: Volume & Usage (live) section header

tiles.name: Live Usage
tiles.description: Live perp volume, open interest, market count, take rate (Hyperliquid API).
tiles.explain: Live activity on Hyperliquid: 24-hour trading volume in perpetual futures, open interest (the value of positions still open), the number of listed markets, and the take rate (fees as a share of volume).

tiles.name: Live Markets — Volume, OI, Funding
tiles.description: Top Hyperliquid markets by 24h volume, incl. RWA/TradFi perps. Live from the HL info API.
tiles.explain: Hyperliquid's most-traded markets over the last 24 hours, with volume, open interest and funding rate (the periodic payment between long and short traders that keeps a perpetual's price near the underlying).

tiles.name: Top Markets by 24h Volume
tiles.description: Top-15 markets by live 24h volume; orange = RWA/TradFi (heuristic).
tiles.explain: The 15 Hyperliquid markets with the most trading volume over the last 24 hours, in US dollars.

tiles.explain: The prices of HYPE and Bitcoin, each rebased to 100 on the first date both traded, to compare performance.

tiles.name: HYPE–BTC Rolling Correlation
tiles.description: 30-day rolling correlation of HYPE and BTC daily returns — crypto-beta vs decoupled.
tiles.explain: The 30-day rolling correlation between HYPE's and Bitcoin's daily returns, from -1 (move opposite) to +1 (move together).

tiles.name: Correlation Read
tiles.description: Correlation & beta to BTC with a bull/bear interpretation — is HYPE crypto-beta or a hedge?
tiles.explain: A written summary of how closely HYPE has moved with Bitcoin: correlation, beta (how much HYPE moves per 1% move in Bitcoin), and what that means in rising and falling markets.
